## Review checklist

- [ ] Review the version change and upstream release notes/changelog above.
- [ ] Check for breaking changes, required migrations, and compatibility with the workflows using this action.
- [ ] Review the workflow diff, especially permissions, inputs, and any pinned commit digest.
- [ ] Confirm CI and repository-specific checks pass.

## Security review

Check whether the update addresses a published advisory in [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/advisories) or [OSV](https://osv.dev/). Renovate can surface vulnerability information when its data sources detect it, but the absence of an alert is not a security audit and does not prove the update is vulnerability-free.
